node: Grid transformers, high-voltage equipment, switchgear, and conductors
summary: Expanded the universe around the grid-equipment chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Hubbell as a larger, cleaner public-market anchor for utility T&D components. Underfollowed lane: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems, Preformed Line Products for conductor/transmission-line hardware, and Hammond Power Solutions as a US-OTC/Canada-primary transformer pure-play. The strongest second-order signals to verify are backlog growth, utility/data-center order mix, capacity expansion, and qualification/vendor status with utilities, data-center EPCs, and transmission operators.
